candidates.change_summary: Remove the withdraw call so withdrawAll no longer transfers the contract balance.
Withdraw a different amount (depositsCount) instead of the full balance.
Add an extra withdrawal of 1 wei after the full withdrawal.
Remove the ownership check so any caller can execute withdrawAll and other onlyOwner functions.
Invert the ownership check so only non-owners pass the modifier.
Remove the require(msg.sender == owner) check so anyone can call withdraw.
Transfer one wei less than the requested amount, changing the ETH received by the caller.
Ignore the _value parameter and always transfer the contract's full balance.
Replace the low-level call with transfer, which reverts on failure instead of returning false.
Add a success check on the call so a failed call reverts instead of being silently ignored.
Remove the onlyOwner guard so any caller can invoke sendMoney.
Make the onlyOwner check trivially true so any caller passes the guard on sendMoney.
